text:
sam_partnerships: Nimbus asked for an attestation + SKU plan for their open model. Requirements: hosted-only SKU, downloadable/redistrib SKU, SI offline installer. Need legal + infra input.
rachel_legal: We can support two tracks: hosted-only (no download/redistribution) and redistributable (explicit license + higher fee). Add a clause: 'no endorsement implied by Redwood'. Partner must keep attestation metadata intact.
tom_infra: Tech plan: produce manifest.json with artifact_sha256, signer_kid, signer_version, provenance_url, license_sku. Sign manifest with KMS-backed ECDSA and provide signature.sig + public_key.pem. Publish static verifier binaries (linux x86_64, arm64).
emily_pm: Nimbus wants marketplace tile week of May 12; SI co-announce two weeks after. Marketing wants 'Redwood Attested' badge. Need SKU IDs for each track and pricing guidance.
harry_marketing: I'll prepare two tile variants and badge options: 'Redwood Attested' preferred. Need short copy that clarifies attestation != endorsement.
olga_si: Offline SI bundle must include manifest.json, signature.sig, public_key.pem, verifier binary, and signer_version. Many customers require SHA512; can we include both SHA256 and SHA512 in manifest?
tom_infra: Yes, include both sha256 and sha512 fields. For air-gapped verification we'll embed signer_version and provide an allowlist file customers can import. Verifier exit codes: 0 = ok, non-zero = mismatch.
ci_bot: signer-ci: build 3180314100 succeeded :white_check_mark: (artifact: signer-api:3180314100)
sam_partnerships: Draft SKU proposal:
SKU RLW-NIM-HOST-01: hosted-only tile, attestation provided, no downloads.
SKU RLW-NIM-DL-02: hosted + downloadable weights, redistrib add-on available via separate contract.
SKU RLW-NIM-SI-03: SI offline installer bundle, verifier binary, signer cert, licensed for internal deployment.
rachel_legal: Contract snippet for SKU pages: "Artifact attestation confirms origin and integrity but does not alter license rights. Redistribution beyond the purchased SKU requires a separate redistribution license and written approval from Redwood. Partner and customer shall not imply Redwood endorsement"
harry_marketing: I'll draft tile copy and badge assets by Wed. Short badge copy options: 'Redwood Attested', 'Verified by Redwood', 'Signed by Redwood' (leaning first).
olga_si: Requesting signer_kid + rotation policy included in SKU metadata so installers can detect certificate changes.
tom_infra: We'll include signer_kid and a revocation list endpoint; offline bundles include signer_version timestamp and allowlist import file.
emily_pm: Action items: Rachel finalize legal language by Thu EOD; Tom publish manifest schema + verifier binaries by Fri; Harry produce badge + tile copy; Sam to send SKU proposal to Nimbus PM and SI contacts. I'll update the doc and announce cadence.
sam_partnerships: Thanks all  I'll follow up with Nimbus and the SI team once drafts are ready. :thumbsup:
